sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
three escapes to the Nordhavn line

findings.why: Galvanica Eporediese (SUP-E) is registered only as a coater. No approved supplier list is in the documents, so no record covers SUP-E for HB-620, the receiving plant and the customer, and a supplier audit does not approve a part (QP-11 4.1). Absence cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm. The customer is taken as CUST-NOR from the 8D, and the receiving plant is not stated.

The drawing requires MAT-ALSI9CU3 with special characteristic SC-HB620-POR (porosity). The offered casting material is not stated, and no 3.1 material certificate from Galvanica Eporediese is in the documents. A person must obtain the certificate and confirm the alloy.
